quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil engines selected for two additional inland waterway (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Marine order (release): Wärtsilä will supply engines for two inland waterway pusher tugs built by Brazilian shipyard Estaleiro Rio Maguari for LHG Mining's iron-ore logistics on the Paraguay-Parana waterway, each powered by three Wärtsilä 20 engines, plus tools, spare parts, a fuel-consumption guarantee, commissioning support and an extended warranty; booked in Q3 2026, delivery during 2027. It follows a 2025 contract for the same engines for four similar vessels, and Wärtsilä also has service agreements covering other LHG Mining vessels.
quarterly_data.figure: two tugs, three Wärtsilä 20 engines each; booked Q3 2026; delivery 2027
